questions.question: What is a standee line?

options.text: A line where passengers must stand behind.
A line where passengers must stand on.
A line for passengers to use when exiting the bus.
A line on the outside of a bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: A line where passengers must stand behind.
questions.explanation: On a bus, passengers cannot stand in front of the driver's seat. Buses have a line on the floor to show where passengers cannot stand. This line is called a standee line.

questions.question: When roads are wet, what does it mean if other vehicles are not spraying water?

options.text: Ice has formed on the road.
The pavement is dry.
Water is being trapped under the vehicles.
The tires have absorbed all the water.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ice has formed on the road.
questions.explanation: If the road looks wet but other vehicles' wheels are not spraying water, ice has formed on the road. Drive carefully on wet or icy roads.

questions.question: When asked to make a turn during your driving test, you should:

options.text: Use your turn signal only if other cars are nearby.
Check traffic only in the direction you are turning.
Check traffic in all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check traffic in all directions.
questions.explanation: When making a turn during your driving test, check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal.

questions.question: When driving a bus with passengers, you should:

options.text: Talk with the passengers.
Not talk with the passengers.
Ask passengers to watch for hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not talk with the passengers.
questions.explanation: Do not talk with passengers while driving. This can distract you from the road.

questions.question: When crossing railroad tracks during your driving test, you should:

options.text: Pass a slow vehicle on the tracks.
Get out of your vehicle to check for a train.
Not change gears while on the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not change gears while on the tracks.
questions.explanation: Do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes while any part of your vehicle is on railroad tracks.

questions.question: When are people usually the least alert while driving?

options.text: In the morning
In the early evening
Late at night

questions.correctAnswerText: Late at night
questions.explanation: Most drivers are least alert late at night, especially after midnight. This is why tired driving crashes happen more often at night.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Move quickly before other vehicles can enter the lane.
Move slowly in case another vehicle is in the lane.
Not use a turn signal.
Avoid the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move slowly in case another vehicle is in the lane.
questions.explanation: Always change lanes slowly and smoothly. If there is a vehicle you did not see, the driver will have more time to react to you.

questions.question: A distracted driver:

options.text: Usually reacts well to hazards.
Usually has slowed perception.
Is usually aware of what is happening around them.
Is a good driver to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Usually has slowed perception.
questions.explanation: Distracted driving may cause slow perception, slow decision-making, and wrong actions. Avoid distracted drivers when possible.

questions.question: A pre-trip vehicle inspection:

options.text: Should be done the same way every time.
Should be done differently every time.
Does not need to include all items every time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be done the same way every time.
questions.explanation: Do your pre-trip vehicle inspection the same way every time. This helps you learn all the steps and makes sure you do not forget to check anything.

questions.question: The radiator cap:

options.text: Should not be removed when the coolant is hot.
Can be removed when the coolant is hot.
Should be cool to the touch during normal driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should not be removed when the coolant is hot.
questions.explanation: Never remove the radiator cap or cooling system parts while hot. Hot steam and boiling water can escape and seriously burn you. If the cap is cool to the touch, the system is cool enough to open.

questions.question: Why are roads especially slippery when rain first starts?

options.text: Water is always very slippery.
Fresh rain mixes with oil on the road.
The water has nowhere to go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fresh rain mixes with oil on the road.
questions.explanation: When rain first starts, it mixes with oil that has dripped onto the road. This creates a very slippery surface.

questions.question: When using your turn signal, what should you do?

options.text: Signal before you begin to turn.
Turn the signal off before you begin to turn.
Signal only if there are vehicles in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal before you begin to turn.
questions.explanation: Always signal well before you turn. This warns other drivers about your plans. Without a signal, drivers might think you are just slowing down.

questions.question: When making a tight turn, what should you do?

options.text: Do not use your mirrors because they can distract you.
Use your mirrors, but not too often.
Check your mirrors often.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors often.
questions.explanation: Always know what is around you. Check your mirrors often, especially when turning, changing lanes, or merging.

questions.question: If a driver coming toward you is using high beam headlights, what should you do?

options.text: Look directly at the headlights.
Flash your high beams to remind them to switch to low beams.
Look toward the right edge of your lane until the vehicle passes.
Pull to the side of the road until the vehicle passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right edge of your lane until the vehicle passes.
questions.explanation: Look away from the bright headlights and toward the right edge of the road. This prevents you from being blinded.

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: Allows you to drive faster.
Allows you to follow other vehicles more closely.
Allows you to drive less carefully.
Does not reduce how far you need to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Does not reduce how far you need to stop.
questions.explanation: ABS helps you stay in control when braking hard. It does not make you stop sooner.

questions.question: Which mirrors should you check while driving?

options.text: Only the passenger side mirror.
Only the driver's side mirror.
Mirrors on both sides of the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Mirrors on both sides of the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Check mirrors on both sides regularly. Know what is behind and beside your vehicle at all times.

questions.question: When you start an engine, how long should it take for oil pressure to reach normal?

options.text: Within seconds.
Within five minutes.
After about three minutes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Within seconds.
questions.explanation: Check your gauges when starting the engine. Oil pressure should reach normal level within a few seconds.

questions.question: What two things tell you when to shift to a higher gear?

options.text: Engine speed and road speed.
Other trucks and road conditions.
Timing and road position.
Oil pressure and air brake pressure.

questions.correctAnswerText: Engine speed and road speed.
questions.explanation: Engine speed (rpm) and road speed (mph) tell you when to shift. Learn your vehicle's rpm range and the speed range for each gear. Shift up when you reach the top of the rpm range or appropriate speed.

questions.question: What is important to do while driving?

options.text: Plan how to escape from dangerous situations.
Enjoy the scenery.
Turn your head around instead of using mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan how to escape from dangerous situations.
questions.explanation: Watch the road for hazards. Think about what you will do if a hazard becomes an emergency.

questions.question: What should you do to help other drivers see your vehicle?

options.text: Keep your headlights clean.
Turn off your headlights during the day.
Cover your headlights with grease.
Use your headlights only when it rains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your headlights clean.
questions.explanation: Clean headlights shine brighter and help other drivers see you.
